race.en: There are long waiting lists to ensure that a new customer won't overload the local network, and in some parts of the United States, these waiting lists stretch to eight years, which is eight years too long if you're a technology company racing to build the next generation of AI.
race.zh: 排队等待的名单很长，以确保新客户不会使当地网络过载，而在美国某些地区，排队时间长达八年，对于一家竞相开发下一代人工智能的科技公司来说，八年实在太漫长了。

rather.en: At least, that's the idea. This is still new technology, largely a technology of blueprints and prototypes rather than working power stations.
rather.zh: 至少，理论上是这样的。这仍是一项新技术，在很大程度上还停留在图纸和原型阶段，而非投入实用的发电站。

rather.en: So the world's biggest technology companies did something unexpected, or I guess rather obvious when you understand that electricity is their biggest constraint .
rather.zh: 于是，全球最大的科技公司做了一件出人意料的事，或者说，当你明白电力是他们最大的瓶颈时，这其实是顺理成章的。

rather.en: British food has a bit of a reputation. I’m sure that for a lot of you, the words “British food” brings to mind boiled vegetables, overcooked meat, greasy breakfasts, and meals that are, above all, rather bland.
rather.zh: 英国食物名声在外。我敢肯定，对你们中的许多人来说，“英国食物”这几个字会让人联想到水煮蔬菜、过熟的肉、油腻的早餐，以及最重要的是，味道相当平淡的饭菜。

rate.en: If banks and investors provide you with €1 billion in financing at a 10% interest rate , let's say, that's €100 million in interest payments every year.
rate.zh: 比方说，如果银行和投资者为你提供10亿欧元的融资，利率为10%，那么每年光是利息支出就有1亿欧元。

rate.en: And the second is that governments are now stepping in to help the financing of new nuclear power stations, guaranteeing the price for a set period, or offering a more manageable interest rate .
rate.zh: 第二，各国政府现在正在介入以协助新核电站的融资，在一定期限内对电价进行托底，或提供更易承受的利率。

radioactive.en: Of course, spent nuclear fuel is dangerous, and it remains radioactive for thousands of years.
radioactive.zh: 当然，乏核燃料确实很危险，而且它的放射性会持续数千年。

range.en: For the first time, many British families had access to a wide range of food.
range.zh: 许多英国家庭有史以来第一次能够接触到种类繁多的食物。
